name: The Corwith household at 1945 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_corwith_mrs_henry

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1945 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1945 Mrs. Henry Corwith; Charles R. Corwith.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1945, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The six live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. Left off: Charlotte McGinnis (a widowed daughter the 1904 Blue Book does not list at the house); Isabelle McGinnis (her daughter, who would go where her mother went). The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. Henry Corwith
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Alma Corwith here as head, born October 1834, in Illinois (as read), widowed (ED 40, sheet 4B, line 60, leaf n801).

persons.name: Charles R. Corwith
persons.note: A son is read from the shared surname under a widow's listing; the Blue Book does not state the relationship. The 1900 census lists Charles R. Corwith here as son, born May 1866, in Illinois, single, real estate (ED 40, sheet 4B, line 61, leaf n801).

persons.name: Hannah Bolin

born.note: The census gives January 1869, age 31 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "House maid" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (house maid); born January 1869, in Sweden, came to the United States in 1891, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.
